links.outcome: LLM detection performance differences across race, sex, and age subgroups
links.effect: No statistically significant differences across race, sex, or age (specificity range 0.91-1; all p-values > 0.05).
links.quote: In subgroup analyses, there was no statistically significant differences across race, sex, or age (specificity range 0.91-1; all p-values > 0.05).

links.outcome: Adjudicated multi-expert reference standard used to evaluate LLM detection of GOC documentation
links.effect: Using an adjudicated reference standard, GPT-4o achieved specificity 0.95, recall 0.74, precision 0.78; manual audit of AI-flagged notes (n=325) showed 86% expert agreement.
links.quote: An interdisciplinary team of palliative care experts created an adjudicated reference standard, which was used to evaluate LLM models in detecting GOC documentation.

screen.reason: This is an empirical study evaluating the enterprise-wide real-time EHR deployment of GPT-4o to identify goals-of-care documentation in clinical notes, assessing diagnostic performance, demographic fairness, and real-world clinical characteristics.
